fusions.name: Flung Dirt
fusions.desc: Flings a clod that deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance of [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Burrow Mound
fusions.desc: Heaps a mound for 6 seconds, 5 tiles long, that deals 12 damage and stuns every enemy it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Landing Soft
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
